prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dazzling, hyper-realistic digital artwork featuring a large, ornate heart made entirely of sparkling diamonds and gemstones, floating majestically above soft, sunlit clouds. The heart is encrusted with intricate facets and shimmering jewels, reflecting light in a radiant, almost magical way. At the center of the heart, the word "BUZZ" is boldly displayed in large, three-dimensional letters, also encrusted with diamonds and outlined in glowing blue neon. The color palette is dominated by icy blues, silvers, and whites, with subtle hints of gold and pastel hues from the sunrise or sunset sky in the background. The lighting is bright and ethereal, with star-like glints and lens flares accentuating the luxurious, glamorous feel. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the clouds below, drawing all attention to the sparkling heart and text. The overall style is cinematic and opulent, reminiscent of high-end jewelry advertisements or fantasy film title sequences, evoking a sense of wonder, excitement, and luxury.
